intuition: A Roman numeral symbol subtracts when it is smaller than the symbol immediately to its right; otherwise it adds.

brute_force.approach: Parse each allowed two-symbol subtractive pair separately, then sum remaining symbols.

optimal.approach: Scan symbols once, adding or subtracting each value based on its next symbol.

edge_cases: A one-symbol numeral is its direct value.
Subtractive pairs include IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, and CM.
The final symbol is always added.
